title: Average Product Price
description:
Calculate the **average price** of all products in the catalog. Return the result rounded to 2 decimal places, aliased as `avg_price`.

**Table: products**

| Column | Type |
|--------|------|
| id | INT |
| name | VARCHAR |
| category | VARCHAR |
| price | DECIMAL |
| stock_quantity | INT |

Output column: `avg_price`.
schema_sql: CREATE TABLE products (id INT, name VARCHAR, category VARCHAR, price DECIMAL, stock_quantity INT); INSERT INTO products VALUES (1, 'Laptop', 'Electronics', 999.99, 10), (2, 'Phone', 'Electronics', 699.99, 25), (3, 'Desk', 'Furniture', 299.99, 5), (4, 'Chair', 'Furniture', 149.99, 8), (5, 'Monitor', 'Electronics', 349.99, 15);
solution_sql: SELECT ROUND(AVG(price), 2) AS avg_price FROM products
hints: AVG() computes the arithmetic mean of a numeric column.
